consensus_view: Street modeling NVDA datacenter revenue to decelerate from triple-digit to mid-40s YoY in FY27 as Blackwell airpocket and hyperscaler digestion compress demand.
variant_view: Blackwell rack-scale (GB200 NVL72) shifts revenue mix to systems where ASP per GPU-equivalent is materially higher than consensus models.
Sovereign AI orders create a non-hyperscaler demand pool that consensus treats as zero through FY27.
Networking attach (NVLink + Spectrum-X) lifts blended datacenter gross margin above the 70% line consensus considers a ceiling.

key_number.bridge: Systems mix shift (+200bps) + networking attach (+100bps) + memory cost easing (+50bps) net of HBM4 ramp (-15bps)

catalysts_positive.event: Hyperscaler FY27 capex guides at Q4 prints
catalysts_positive.implication: If AWS+Azure+GCP+META aggregate >+25% YoY, validates our datacenter run-rate and supports the +200bps mix-shift thesis.
Confirms cadence to 1-year product cycle, sustaining ASP power and locking in CY27 visibility.

catalysts_negative.implication: Long-cycle accelerator demand re-rates; datacenter revenue growth compresses below consensus and our margin bridge breaks.

falsifiers: Q+1 datacenter sequential growth <+5% with networking attach not improving — kills mix-shift mechanism.
Blackwell systems ASP printed below $3M per NVL72 rack at next conference — kills the rack-scale repricing story.

primary_quotes.speaker: CFO Colette Kress
primary_quotes.quote: Demand for Blackwell is extraordinary and we expect significant Blackwell revenue in Q1.

primary_quotes.speaker: CEO Jensen Huang
primary_quotes.quote: We are now in the era of accelerated computing and generative AI, and the runway is measured in trillions.

asymmetry: Skewed upside: bull case +45% on Rubin pull-forward and sovereign AI orders compounding; bear case -22% on hyperscaler digestion deeper than two quarters.
